question: How many days of paid annual leave does a full-time employee get?
reference_answer: Full-time employees get 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

evidence.quote: Every full-time employee at Fernhill Analytics receives 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

question: How many unused holiday days can I carry over into the next year?
reference_answer: You can carry over a maximum of 5 unused days, and they must be used by 31 March.

evidence.quote: You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused days into the next calendar year.

question: By what time do I have to tell my manager that I am off sick?
reference_answer: Tell your line manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence, directly rather than in the team channel.

evidence.quote: If you are too unwell to work, tell your line manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence.

question: For how many days can I self-certify a sickness absence?
reference_answer: You can self-certify sickness absence for up to 7 calendar days.

evidence.quote: You can self-certify sickness absence for up to 7 calendar days.

question: What is the maximum hotel rate per night in London?
reference_answer: Hotels in London are capped at 180 GBP per night.

evidence.quote: Hotel rates are capped at 180 GBP per night in London and 130 GBP per night elsewhere in the United Kingdom.

question: What meal allowance can I claim per day while travelling?
reference_answer: Up to 45 GBP per day for food, claimed through Ledgerly.

evidence.quote: While travelling you may claim a meal allowance of up to 45 GBP per day for food, using the expenses process in Ledgerly.

question: Within how many days of the purchase must I claim a business expense?
reference_answer: Claim within 30 days of the purchase date in Ledgerly; claims more than 60 days after purchase are rejected.

evidence.quote: Business expenses are claimed in the Ledgerly expenses app within 30 days of the purchase date.

question: What is the minimum length for a work password?
reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and stored in Keystone.

evidence.quote: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and stored in the company password manager, Keystone.

question: How often are laptops refreshed?
reference_answer: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years.

evidence.quote: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years.

question: Up to what value can I accept a gift from a supplier?
reference_answer: You may accept gifts or hospitality worth up to 50 GBP; above that they must be declared.

evidence.quote: You may accept gifts or hospitality from suppliers worth up to 50 GBP.

question: How much does Fernhill contribute to my pension?
reference_answer: Fernhill contributes 6 percent of base salary when you contribute at least 4 percent.

evidence.quote: Fernhill contributes 6 percent of base salary to the company pension scheme when you contribute at least 4 percent.

question: How long is the probation period for new joiners?
reference_answer: The probation period is 6 months.

evidence.quote: The probation period is 6 months.

question: How big is my personal learning budget each year?
reference_answer: Each employee has a learning budget of 1,200 GBP per calendar year, which does not roll over.

evidence.quote: Each employee has a personal learning budget of 1,200 GBP per calendar year for courses, conferences, books and certifications.

question: What allowance do I get for a week of on-call cover?
reference_answer: The on-call allowance is 250 GBP per week of cover, plus time off in lieu for long incident work.

evidence.quote: Employees on the on-call rota receive an allowance of 250 GBP per week of on-call cover, plus time off in lieu for any incident work outside working hours longer than 2 hours.

question: How many days per week am I expected to be in the office?
reference_answer: At least 2 days per week, including your team's shared anchor day.

evidence.quote: Employees are expected in the office on at least 2 days per week, and every team agrees one shared anchor day when everyone attends.

question: How many weeks of partner leave at full pay do second parents get?
reference_answer: Partners and second parents get 8 weeks of partner leave at full pay.

evidence.quote: Partners and second parents receive 8 weeks of paternity or partner leave at full pay, which can be taken in up to two blocks within the first 12 months after the birth or adoption.

question: I have worked here for 6 years. How many annual leave days do I get, and how many can I carry over?
reference_answer: After 5 years of service the allowance is 28 days, and you can carry over at most 5 unused days.

evidence.quote: After 5 years of continuous service, your allowance increases to 28 days.
You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused days into the next calendar year.

question: A conference ticket costs 620 GBP. Does learning budget spending need approval in advance, and who approves an expense claim above 500 GBP?

evidence.quote: Spending from the learning budget needs manager approval in advance through Harbour.
Claims above 500 GBP also need approval from the budget holder in Finance.

question: During probation, what is my notice period, and by when must I finish security awareness training?
reference_answer: During probation the notice period is 1 week, and security awareness training must be completed within 14 days of joining.

evidence.quote: During probation the notice period on either side is 1 week.
All employees complete security awareness training within 14 days of joining and then once every 12 months.

question: If I am rated Below Expectations, am I eligible for a pay increase, and how long does the improvement plan last?
reference_answer: No, Below Expectations means no pay increase that cycle, and the performance improvement plan lasts 8 to 12 weeks.

evidence.quote: Employees rated Below Expectations are not eligible for a pay increase in that cycle.
If your rating is Below Expectations, your manager agrees a performance improvement plan with you lasting 8 to 12 weeks, with fortnightly check-ins.

question: When I leave the company, how long do I have to return my laptop, and is unused annual leave paid out?
reference_answer: Equipment must be returned within 5 working days of your last day, and unused leave is paid out when you leave the company.

evidence.quote: When you leave the company, all equipment must be returned within 5 working days of your last day.
Unused leave beyond the carry-over limit is not paid out, except when you leave the company.

question: How much does life assurance pay, and from when am I covered by private medical insurance?
reference_answer: Life assurance pays four times base salary, and private medical insurance covers you from your first day.

evidence.quote: Life assurance pays four times your base salary.
Private medical insurance covers you from your first day.

question: If I am off sick for 25 working days this year, how much of that is on full salary, and when do I need a fit note?
reference_answer: Full salary is paid for up to 20 working days in a rolling 12 months, then half salary; a fit note is needed for absences longer than 7 calendar days.

evidence.quote: Fernhill pays full salary for up to 20 working days of sickness absence in any rolling 12-month period.
For absences longer than 7 calendar days you must provide a fit note from a doctor, uploaded to Harbour.

question: I want to work from another country for three weeks. How far ahead must I request it, and how must I connect to internal systems while there?

evidence.quote: Requests must be submitted in Harbour at least 15 working days before travel.
When working remotely you must use the company VPN for any access to internal systems, and you must not work from public networks without the VPN enabled.
